_help: Al-Ikhlas images (003). Same format as 002: start = spoken line it first appears on, or 'ayah' = from that Arabic block's swoosh (AYAH 1 = whole surah, AYAH 2..5 = ayah 1..4). reuse_id = an image already in this story (free crop/zoom, rect). FREE FIRST (user 2026-10-30): all 9 new images are for scripts/cf_image.py (Cloudflare flux, Rs0); paid Gemini only if the free engine fails or a picture is unusable - write the reason in log.md first. 9 new images (max 8-10) + 7 free crops; prompts = places/sky/light/one clay lamp only, simple and concrete; the builder adds the style block. Every new prompt ends 'No people, no animals, no text, no writing.' Never any Prophet/Sahabi/angel/person, no depiction of Allah, no child/family scene (112:3), no domes/minarets/modern buildings, no red sandstone/mesas (carry_over 001/002), Arabian landscapes only, one matte painted family (carry_over 002 images R1: 06/08/11 were over-saturated). Pehle ~60 s: 01 (0-7 s), 02 (7-14), 04 (14-21), 01 crop (21-29), 06 (29-40, builder splits at 8 s), 03 (40-48), 03 crop (48+): nothing longer than ~8 s.
